value: Training pipeline has stages: Multimodal Continual Pre-Training (CPT), Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), and Cascade Reinforcement Learning (CascadeRL). In CascadeRL, the model is first fine-tuned with Mixed Preference Optimization (MPO) under offline RL, followed by GSPO under online RL. The Flash version additionally has Visual Consistency Learning (ViCO).
quote: Our training pipeline comprises four stages: Multimodal Continual Pre-Training (**CPT**), Supervised Fine-Tuning (**SFT**), and Cascade Reinforcement Learning (**CascadeRL**). In CascadeRL, we first fine-tune the model using Mixed Preference Optimization (**MPO**) under an offline RL setting, followed by **GSPO** under an oneline RL setting. [...] For the Flash version of InternVL3.5, we additionally introduce a lightweight training stage, termed Visual Consistency Learning (**ViCO**), which reduces the token cost required to represent an image patch.
quotes: Our training pipeline comprises four stages: Multimodal Continual Pre-Training (**CPT**), Supervised Fine-Tuning (**SFT**), and Cascade Reinforcement Learning (**CascadeRL**). In CascadeRL, we first fine-tune the model using Mixed Preference Optimization (**MPO**) under an offline RL setting, followed by **GSPO** under an oneline RL setting.

For the Flash version of InternVL3.5, we additionally introduce a lightweight training stage, termed Visual Consistency Learning (**ViCO**), which reduces the token cost required to represent an image patch.

value: Cascade RL combines offline RL (MPO) as an efficient warm-up to reach satisfied results and guarantee high-quality rollouts, then online RL (GSPO) to refine the output distribution from the model's own rollouts; this achieves significant performance improvements at a fraction of the GPU time cost versus a single offline or online RL stage. GSPO was chosen because it was found more effective for training both dense and MoE models. In pre-training, square averaging re-weights the NTP loss to mitigate bias toward longer or shorter responses. SFT thinking data filters out rollouts with incorrect final answers.
quote: Cascade RL aims to combine the benefits of offline RL and online RL to progressively facilitate the post-training of MLLMs in an efficient manner. [...] Specifically, we first fine-tune the model using an offline RL algorithm as an efficient warm-up stage to reach a satisfied results, which can guarantee the high-quality rollouts for the latter stage. [...] Subsequently, we employ an online RL algorithm to further refine the output distribution based on rollouts generated by the model itself.  Compared to the single offline or online RL stage, our cascaded RL achieves significant performance improvements at a fraction of the GPU time cost. [...] During the online RL stage, we employ GSPO, without reference model constraints, as our online RL algorithm, which we find more effective in training both dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models. [...] Additionally, to mitigate bias toward either longer or shorter responses during training, we adopt the square averaging to re-weight the NTP loss  as follows: [...] Rollouts with an incorrect final answer are filtered out.
quotes: Cascade RL aims to combine the benefits of offline RL and online RL to progressively facilitate the post-training of MLLMs in an efficient manner.

Specifically, we first fine-tune the model using an offline RL algorithm as an efficient warm-up stage to reach a satisfied results, which can guarantee the high-quality rollouts for the latter stage.

Subsequently, we employ an online RL algorithm to further refine the output distribution based on rollouts generated by the model itself.  Compared to the single offline or online RL stage, our cascaded RL achieves significant performance improvements at a fraction of the GPU time cost.
During the online RL stage, we employ GSPO, without reference model constraints, as our online RL algorithm, which we find more effective in training both dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models.

value: The card has no dedicated limitations section. It notes only a few technical caveats. Thinking mode can produce undesired repetition, which it recommends mitigating with do_sample=True and temperature=0.6. LMDeploy does not yet support GPT-OSS, so vLLM is recommended for InternVL3.5-20B-A4B. The 20B version requires transformers>=4.55.0.
quote: When enabling Thinking mode, we recommend setting `do_sample=True` and `temperature=0.6` to mitigate undesired repetition.
